inputs.thermal_telemetry: pmset therm unavailable (0xe00002bc); no temperature or no-throttling claim

calibration.method: Passive sampling of the existing benchmark server; no added CPU task

rusage_cpu_clock.legacy_field_note: Framework main/startup and early controls called these fields user_ns/system_ns; they contain raw Mach ticks, not nanoseconds. Analysis must convert. Newer runner labels them user_ticks/system_ticks.

inference_limits: Closed-loop client/server/database on one shared laptop. Bootstrap resamples matched blocks within this pass; it is not a cross-host or production confidence interval. Report raw spread and same-mode controls alongside ratios. Physical and RSS metrics are distinct; database memory is excluded from server memory.
